text_block_list.text: (Waaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, you really have grown strong. 
Just like her, you too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lending you a hand was well worth it. 
Thank you, Phaleno-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You exceeded all my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Hah*, *hah*, *hah*...—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I squeezed out every last ounce, 
gave it everything! 
It feels as though my limbs might tear 
apart!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And yet—it feels magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once again... 
I was able to show them who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have returned.
choice_data_list:
Great job! All that training really paid 
off!

Welcome back! All that training really 
paid off!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's all thanks to Hayahide's help. 
I'll be sure to thank her later.

Having that conversation, as we started 
heading 
toward the waiting room with Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis-san! 
Great work in the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You handled the longer distance so well, 
squeezing out 
every last drop of stamina until the very 
end... 
I found myself clenching my fists without 
even realizing it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I also read your interview article! 
Repaying the club that made it possible 
for you to run— 
I was deeply moved by the reason you race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So if you have some free time at a later 
date... 
would you be willing to sit down for an 
interview for our program?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An interview? 
Hmm...
choice_data_list:
It could be a great chance to spread the 
word about the club, you know?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. 
In that case—I would be glad to.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“In short, the reason I can achieve 
results in the 
Twinkle Series is entirely thanks to 
everyone's support— 
both the club, and my Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“—To continuously live up to the 
expectations placed upon me. 
Beyond that lies the cherished dream I 
must achieve.”

text_block_list.name: Race Program MC
text_block_list.text:
Man, this week's 'Featured Umamusume' 
segment 
was incredible to watch! 
Phalaenopsis-san's reason 
for running is just so wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely... Seeing a girl like her 
steadily earning 
recognition in the racing world really 
tugs 
at the heartstrings.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
...Any ordinary Umamusume would have 
probably thought 
about giving up on racing at some point. 
Yet, she refused to do that.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She pushed herself with the single-minded 
desire to run— 
and precisely because she's that kind of 
person, 
she was blessed with such understanding 
people.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, her reason for running 
is to repay them! 
How could anyone not root for her?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
All eyes will be on how she continues to 
meet 
our expectations from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
...Man. 
I truly can't help but cheer for her now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. 
That was quite a sincere feature.

It succinctly showcased the club's 
devotion and her way 
of living up to it—and the studio panel 
was left 
genuinely moved as a result.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Though I feel certain details 
were embellished a bit too grandly.
choice_data_list:
Not at all. In fact, there really is a 
dramatic story in your hoofprints.

Not at all. In fact, there really is a 
dramatic story in your hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Flattery will get you nothing, you know. 
...Though I do have candy. Would you like 
one?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of which... I was thinking of 
dropping 
by the club again this weekend. What do 
you think?
choice_data_list: *roll, roll*... Yeah, I'll come along too!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Club Members
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa... This place is so pretty!” 
“Ah! Isn't that Phalaeno-san?!” 
“Nice to meet you!”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? What is this? 
There are quite a few unfamiliar young 
fillies here.

text_block_list.name: Club Female Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! After that television 
feature on you, 
we've had an influx of girls wanting to 
check out the club!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see, is that so? 
It brings me joy to hear such good news.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is a wonderful place. 
Please take your time and look around.

text_block_list.name: Prospective Club Members
text_block_list.text:
“Okay!” “Y-Yes ma'am!” 
“Sure thing, thanks for having us!”

text_block_list.name: Prospective Member Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! If it's all right with you... 
I'd really love it if you could coach me, 
Phalaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems there are some with real 
backbone here. 
Very well. As your senior—I shall polish 
you into shape.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Club Members
text_block_list.text:
“Wait, she's so fast...?!” “Whaaaat?!” 
“Guh... So this is an active racer... 
Whoaaaa!”

I chuckled quietly so Phalaenopsis 
wouldn't notice. 
After all, today she had been running at a 
slightly faster pace 
right from the very start.
choice_data_list:
(She must be happy to see more juniors 
joining.)

text_block_list.name: Prospective Club Members
text_block_list.text:
"*Hah, hah...*" "She was so fast..." 
"Th-Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You showed fine promise as well. 
If you wish to aim higher, then dedicate 
yourselves here.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... We have a few more girls scheduled 
to come observe after this. Would you like 
to stay and watch?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
If we would not be in the way.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: The club was really lively, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed...
choice_data_list: Everyone was so moved by your hard work!

Everyone was deeply touched by your 
dedication!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, do not frolic like a child. 
Surely you understand as well, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We are still only halfway there. This was 
merely 
another tribute of gratitude adorning our 
garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yet. 
If we continue to take these steps 
forward—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Someday, without fail.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...The third crown of the Triple Tiara. 
Our next race is the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We shall seize it, Trainer. 
For the glorious future that awaits us.

I found myself clenching my fist. 
Witnessing the club flourish, 
and above all, catching a glimpse of a 
future where her dream comes true, 
filled me with even greater resolve.
choice_data_list:
(I'll make sure she wins the next one 
too.)

text_block_list.text:
Spring departed, and a lukewarm breeze 
brushed against my cheek— 
Heading toward the Shuka Sho, we were 
going to push ourselves this summer!
